statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); used_pct=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); effort=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.effort.level // empty'); dir=$(basename "$cwd"); branch=''; if [ -d "$cwd/.git" ] || git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); fi; printf "\033[38;5;117m%s\033[0m" "$dir"; [ -n "$branch" ] && printf " \033[38;5;179m %s\033[0m" "$branch"; printf " \033[38;5;150m%s\033[0m" "$model"; [ -n "$effort" ] && printf " \033[38;5;215m⚡%s\033[0m" "$effort"; if [ -n "$used_pct" ]; then used_int=$(printf "%.0f" "$used_pct"); filled=$((used_int / 5)); empty=$((20 - filled)); bar='['; i=0; while [ $i -lt $filled ]; do bar="${bar}█"; i=$((i+1)); done; i=0; while [ $i -lt $empty ]; do bar="${bar}░"; i=$((i+1)); done; bar="${bar}] ${used_int}%"; printf " \033[38;5;141m%s\033[0m" "$bar"; fi

subagentStatusLine.command: jq -c '.tasks[] | select(.model) | {id, content: (((.label // .description // "agent")[0:48]) + " · " + (.model|sub("^claude-";"")) + (if .effort then " " + (.effort|tostring) else "" end))}'
